text:
Maya: quick review request  draft of product launch blog intro below. Need legal + eng signoff before we lock hero claim and CTAs.

Maya: Intro: Redwood Inference provides a single runtime for hosted, dedicated, and private inference with predictable latency and cost. In benchmarked scenarios we observed up to 3.8x lower per-token cost for production workloads.*

Tom: suggest hedging number to "up to 3.8x" and include a one-liner about workload shape (avg seq ~64, bursty requests).

Rina: headline idea: "Inference that meets your SLOs, wherever you run it." will prep hero comp and OG image. Need copy length for alt text.

LegalBot: claim detected. Please attach methodology or switch to "in our benchmarked scenarios". Avoid implying guaranteed savings.

Sam: I'll own the benchmark appendix. Will include model, hardware, seq distribution, batching settings, and raw CSV. ETA Apr 5.

Maya: webinar ops: 45-min tech session (demo + Q&A) target week Apr 14. Ops, can you reserve studio and HubSpot flow?

OpsBot: noted. HubSpot flow id 98765 reserved. Publish window suggestion: 2026-04-09T09:00-07:00. Ensure assets in /assets/blog/inference-launch-2026.

Maya: action items: Legal pass by EOD tomorrow; Sam upload appendix by Apr 5; Rina hero comps by Apr 7. I'll update copy once legal approves. :rocket:
